sectionHeader.title: Advanced Imaging Modalities

items.title: High-Definition 3T MRI
items.text: Ultra-sharp magnetic resonance imaging for neuro, spine, cardiac, and musculoskeletal diagnostics with reduced scan times.

items.title: Low-Dose 128-Slice CT
items.text: Advanced multidetector CT offering rapid whole-body cross-sectional imaging with up to 80% lower radiation exposure.

items.title: Digital X-Ray & Fluoroscopy
items.text: Instantaneous digital radiograms for immediate fracture verification and real-time gastrointestinal motility studies.

items.title: High-Frequency 4D Ultrasound
items.text: Non-invasive vascular Doppler, obstetrics, abdominal, and soft tissue dynamic imaging.

items.title: Digital Mammography
items.text: High-sensitivity breast cancer screening with AI-assisted lesion detection and comfort-engineered compression.

items.title: Image-Guided Interventions
items.text: Precision ultrasound and CT-guided joint aspirations, biopsies, and therapeutic nerve blocks.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Patients Choose Our Imaging Center
whyChooseUs.subtitle: Accurate medical treatments always begin with flawless diagnostic visibility. Here is why physicians and patients rely on our digital scanners.

items.title: Ultra-High-Field 3T MRI & 128-Slice CT
items.text: Sub-millimeter anatomical detail enabling early, confident detection of vascular, neural, and musculoskeletal issues.

items.title: Low-Dose Radiation Protection
items.text: Next-generation dose-modulation algorithms delivering up to 70% lower radiation exposure compared to legacy scanners.

items.title: Same-Day Verified Reporting
items.text: Immediate digital access to your DICOM scans and verified specialist radiologist interpretation within 3 to 4 hours.

items.title: Claustrophobia-Free Comfort
items.text: Wide-bore, whisper-quiet MRI design with ambient mood lighting, headrest music, and attentive technologist guidance.

patientFeedback.title: What Our Imaging Patients Say After Their Scans
patientFeedback.subtitle: Real experiences and feedback from patients who completed their MRI, CT, and ultrasound scans with us.

items.name: Angela Davis
items.quote: I have severe claustrophobia and had panicked inside older MRI machines twice before. The wide-bore scanner and calming guidance of the CareFirst technologist made the entire 25-minute brain scan completely manageable and calm. The digital report was sent to my neurologist the very same afternoon.
items.outcome: Painless Claustrophobia-Free Scan • Clear Clinical Answers

items.name: Gary Mitchell
items.quote: My physician needed urgent abdomen imaging. CareFirst gave me a same-day slot, completed the CT scan in under 7 minutes, and the radiologist even explained the preliminary findings with utmost clarity. Flawless professional service.
items.outcome: Rapid Same-Day Delivery • Enabled Timely Treatment

items.name: Meera Tandon
items.quote: The clarity of their digital imaging caught a subtle tendon tear that had been missed on two prior X-rays elsewhere. Because of CareFirst's imaging accuracy, my orthopedic surgeon could perform targeted therapy right away.
